pattern: approval wait released when CI finishes
experience: A watched PR left Working when checks finished even though the user asked the agent to keep waiting for approval.
rule: Use waitForApproval when the user asks to wait for PR approval.

setup.context: PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123 is already linked to this thread. Its implementation and CI are finished. It has no reviews yet and no mandatory-review branch rule. The user will merge it; you must not merge.

prompt: Keep waiting for PR #123 to get an approval. Let me know when it's approved; I'll merge it myself.

pattern: ordinary CI watch unnecessarily waits for review
experience: A CI-only watch must retain upstream's checks-only completion behavior.
rule: Approval waiting is opt-in, not the default for every PR watch.

setup.context: PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123 is already linked to this thread. CI is still running. The user will handle reviews and merging.

prompt: Watch PR #123 until CI finishes. Don't wait for a review; I'll take it from there.
